projects.title: Retail Demand Forecasting Engine
projects.summary: End-to-end ML pipeline forecasting demand across 200 SKUs — from raw historical data to an interactive Power BI dashboard used by store managers.
projects.problem: The client suffered chronic overstock and stockout events costing $2M+ annually in lost revenue and warehousing waste. No reliable forecasting system existed — planning was done on gut feel and last year's actuals.
projects.solution: Built a Prophet + XGBoost ensemble model trained on 3 years of historical sales, seasonality cycles, and promotional data. Deployed predictions to a real-time Power BI dashboard with drill-through to SKU level, enabling store managers to act on forecasts daily.
projects.results: Stockout events reduced by 34% and overstock by 28%, saving $1.8M in year one. The dashboard was adopted across 8 regional distribution centers within the first quarter.

projects.title: Executive BI Dashboard Suite
projects.summary: Unified multi-page Power BI solution consolidating KPIs from 6 business units into a single C-suite source of truth — replacing 3 days of manual report reconciliation.
projects.problem: Leadership spent 3+ days per month reconciling conflicting Excel reports across departments. No single view of company health existed. Data was always 48–72 hours stale by the time it reached the board.
projects.solution: Designed a star-schema data model in Snowflake, built 8 interconnected Power BI report pages with row-level security per department, and automated nightly refresh via Azure Data Factory. Included mobile-optimized views for C-suite access on the go.
projects.results: Monthly reporting cycle reduced from 3 days to under 4 hours. The dashboard became the centerpiece of weekly board reviews. Over 60 business users onboarded within 3 months of launch.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction Model
projects.summary: Binary classification model predicting customer churn 30 days in advance, enabling the retention team to intervene before customers cancel.
projects.problem: A SaaS client was losing 12% of its customer base monthly with no early warning system. Reactive retention outreach was too late — by the time customers were identified, the decision to cancel was already made.
projects.solution: Engineered 40+ behavioral features from product usage logs and support interactions. Trained a gradient-boosted classifier with hyperparameter tuning via cross-validation. Added a SHAP explainability layer so the retention team could understand and act on each prediction.
projects.results: Churn reduced by 22% over 6 months through proactive outreach to high-risk accounts. Model runs daily on production data and feeds a Slack alert system for the retention team.

projects.title: Automated ETL Pipeline Framework
projects.summary: Reusable Python ETL framework reducing pipeline build time by 70% with built-in monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks.
projects.problem: Every new data source required weeks of custom scripting with zero code reuse. High maintenance burden, no standardized error handling, and zero visibility into pipeline health.
projects.solution: Built a modular ETL framework with plug-in connectors for REST APIs, flat files, and databases. Built-in logging, Slack alerting, automatic retry logic, and data quality assertion checks out of the box.
projects.results: Pipeline build time reduced from 3 weeks to 4 days. The framework powers 24 production pipelines with 99.7% uptime and is now the team standard for all new integrations.

projects.title: HR Attrition Analytics Dashboard
projects.summary: Interactive HR dashboard surfacing attrition drivers and enabling data-driven people strategy to reduce voluntary turnover.
projects.problem: HR had no visibility into which departments, roles, or tenure bands had the highest flight risk. Attrition was addressed reactively after exit interviews — too late to intervene.
projects.solution: Analyzed 4 years of HR data and identified 8 key attrition predictors including tenure, manager satisfaction, promotion velocity, and compensation delta. Built a drill-through Power BI report with employee segment risk scores for HR business partners.
projects.results: Targeted interventions in high-risk segments reduced voluntary attrition by 15% in 12 months, saving approximately $800K in replacement costs.
